symbolDescription: Imperative control of a mounted globe, from a `ref` or `onReady`. Its identity is stable for the life of the mount.

optionDescriptions.setCamera: Moves the camera to a pose; members left out keep their current value. Animated unless `animate: false` or reduced motion is on.
optionDescriptions.reset: Returns the camera to the pose the globe opened on: centre, zoom and tilt.
optionDescriptions.flyTo: Flies the camera to centre a coordinate, optionally at a new zoom.
optionDescriptions.zoomIn: Moves the camera closer by a fraction of the current distance (default 0.2).
optionDescriptions.zoomOut: Moves the camera away by a fraction of the current distance (default 0.2).
optionDescriptions.startAutoRotate: Spins the globe until stopped. Speed 1 is about 7 degrees per second. Paused under reduced motion.
optionDescriptions.latLngToScreen: Projects a coordinate into the container; null when the globe hides it.
optionDescriptions.screenToLatLng: The coordinate under a container point; null when the ray misses the globe.
